correspondences.notes: Evaluation metrics; BIDS 1.11.2 has no counterpart.

brainlife.desc: metrics.json comparing a segmentation with a ground-truth mask: voxel overlap, neighbour-corrected, topology and component metrics.
brainlife.name: neuro/seg-eval-metrics

original.desc: Segmentation/mask evaluation metrics (voxel, target-informed neighbor-corrected, topology, connected-component) output as JSON, produced by the seg-eval-metrics app.

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Benchmarking segmentation methods, e.g. axon segmentation of microscopy.

**Not for:** Comparing masks of different shapes or grids.

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 1 (aggregated, non-revealing) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 1 App, output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.seg-eval-metrics.json

files.desc: Evaluation metrics JSON (voxel/topology/component comparisons of a moving mask against a ground-truth mask).

identifying_risks: None expected; numbers summarise mask agreement
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 2: summary scores that reveal no participant-level neurodata.
sharing_cautions: Check embedded dataset IDs before release
tier_conditions: Tier 2 if the JSON embeds participant identifiers or images

inputs_of.name: Segmentation evaluation metric aggregation
inputs_of.purpose: aggregates a batch of CONNECTS segmentation evaluation metrics into per-metric means and population standard

intended_use: Benchmarking segmentation methods, e.g. axon segmentation of microscopy.
not_suitable_for: Comparing masks of different shapes or grids.

outputs_of.name: CONNECTS Validation Engine
outputs_of.purpose: evaluates a 3D segmentation against a ground-truth mask, computing voxel overlap
